description: Conversational wizard that configures a scheduled cost-reduction tick (`tenx-recur`): each run clones the policy repo, recomputes the plan and pushes the changes. Walks the user through seven decisions: target services, savings target (%), tick schedule, scheduler runtime, gitops config repo, exception services, and final confirm, then emits two ready-to-commit artifacts: `policy.yaml` (the declarative policy the tick CLI consumes) and a scheduler manifest (Kubernetes CronJob YAML, GitHub Actions workflow, or crontab entry + wrapper script depending on the chosen scheduler). Each call merges the latest answer into the wizard session and either asks the next missing question or emits the artifacts once all answers are present. Re-invoke with the same `session_id` on every subsequent turn; sessions live 30 minutes. To skip interactive Q&A, supply all fields (`target_services`, `target_percent`, `schedule`, `scheduler`, `config_plane`, `confirm: true`) in a single call. Optional overrides: `exceptions` (services never touched), `min_delta_pp` (minimum savings delta before committing a new CSV, default 2pp), `env_id`, `namespace`, `secret_name`. Datadog Standard budget: `budget_usd_monthly` (X, the whole account's Standard bill a month) replaces the savings target and makes the tick the budget run, held month to date from Datadog's estimated usage metric: on `k8s_cron` it runs in the Receiver's namespace with a service account, writes caps.csv, actions.csv, totals.csv (with a `*` row) and config-generation.csv into the policy ConfigMap and discovers node counts; on `github_actions` it commits the same files for the engine's gitops pull with `nodes_by_container`. With it: `standard_indexes`, `standard_rate_per_million`, `keep_count`, `datadog_secret_name`. The Receiver must be installed with `regulator_unit: "events"` on engine 1.1.146 or later. Apply instructions for the chosen scheduler are in `data.apply_instructions`. After the first tick runs, call `log10x_commitment_report` to verify realized savings. REQUIRES nothing deployed to ASK: it renders manifests from the user's answers and writes to no account. The emitted tick needs a scheduler runtime (k8s CronJob, GitHub Actions, crontab, EventBridge, Container Apps job) and a policy repo or S3 prefix that the customer controls before it runs.

budget_gb_monthly.description: VOLUME BUDGET: keep monthly ingest for the targeted services at or under this many GB/mo. A standing line, not a one-shot cut: each tick scales the budget to its lookback window and cuts only the overage: already under budget means every pattern passes. Replaces target_percent in policy.yaml (mutually exclusive). Dollar budgets are a one-shot answer via log10x_estimate_savings (budget_usd_monthly); the recurring tick is byte-denominated.

budget_usd_monthly.description: DATADOG STANDARD BUDGET: dollars a month of Standard indexing for the whole account, held month to date. Each run reads what Standard counted this month (Datadog's estimated usage metric), subtracts lines that do not pass the Receiver, gives the Receiver's services the rest for the hours left, and writes caps.csv, actions.csv and totals.csv (with a `*` row for every other service), counted in events. Runs on scheduler k8s_cron (writes the policy ConfigMap in the cluster, discovers node counts) or github_actions (commits the files for the engine's gitops pull, node counts from `nodes_by_container`). Replaces target_percent and budget_gb_monthly. The Receiver must be installed with `regulator_unit: "events"` on engine 1.1.146 or later.

config_plane.description: Where the recurring CLI reads policy.yaml and writes updated cap CSVs: a gitops repo URL (e.g. https://github.com/acme/log10x-config), a local path, or (required when scheduler=eventbridge) an S3 prefix (e.g. s3://acme-logs/log10x-config).

confirm.description: Set to true to confirm the configuration and emit the artifacts. The wizard asks for confirmation interactively when omitted.

datadog_secret_name.description: With budget_usd_monthly on k8s_cron: the Secret holding DD_PAT (or DD_API_KEY and DD_APP_KEY) and optional DD_SITE. Default: log10x-datadog.

env_id.description: Log10x environment ID. Auto-detected from LOG10X_ENV_ID when absent.

exceptions.description: Service names the policy must never touch (audit / regulatory / executive). Optional: defaults to empty. Pass [] to explicitly clear all exceptions.

keep_count.description: With budget_usd_monthly: error lines over a limit that pass per statement per node per window. Default 50.

min_delta_pp.description: Minimum change in savings percentage points required before the tick commits a new CSV. Default: 2. Set to 0 to commit on every tick.

namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace for the CronJob. Default: log10x. Only used when scheduler=k8s_cron.

nodes_by_container.description: With budget_usd_monthly on github_actions: the nodes each service's pods run on. The run divides every limit by them.

schedule.description: Tick schedule. Presets: hourly (the default for budget_usd_monthly), daily-03utc (the default otherwise), every-6h, every-12h, every-24h-localtz. Or pass a raw 5-field cron expression (e.g. "0 5 * * 1").

scheduler.description: Where the recurring tick runs. k8s_cron = Kubernetes CronJob (default when kubectl reachable), github_actions = GHA workflow, crontab = crontab + wrapper script, eventbridge = AWS-native (EventBridge Scheduler + CodeBuild, S3 config plane: no cluster, no GitHub; the fit for AWS serverless estates), container_apps_job = Azure-native (Container Apps scheduled Job, git config plane; the fit for Azure serverless estates).

secret_name.description: Name of the Kubernetes Secret holding LOG10X_API_KEY. Default: log10x-secret. Only used when scheduler=k8s_cron.

service_budgets.description: With budget_usd_monthly: dollars a month of Standard for a named service (the container), e.g. {"payments": 4000}, or {"payments": {"usd": 4000, "datadog_service": "payments-api"}} when Datadog tags it with another service name. Each run holds that service month to date against its own number, from Datadog's usage count under that service tag, and holds the rest of the account to budget_usd_monthly minus their sum. The sum must be under budget_usd_monthly, and a service in exceptions cannot have one.

session_id.description: Wizard session handle. Omit on the first call: a new session is minted and returned. Pass it back unchanged on every subsequent call.

standard_indexes.description: With budget_usd_monthly: the Datadog index names that bill as Standard. Omit to count every index.

standard_rate_per_million.description: With budget_usd_monthly: the account's Standard indexing rate, dollars per million events. Default: list, $1.70.

target_percent.description: Desired savings target, as a percentage of current log volume (1-95). Default: 30. The CLI's per-pattern planner works backward from this target.

target_services.description: Services the policy targets. Empty array = all services. Use service names from `log10x_services`. The wizard asks if omitted.

title: Set up recurring cost-reduction
